clue.text: Graves may be found in such underground chambers

definitions.text: Graves may be found in such underground chambers

parts.words: Graves may be found in such underground chambers
parts.note: the surface suggests tombs in a crypt, but Graves is a Bordeaux wine, kept in cellars below ground

explanation.surface: Burial plots turn up in subterranean crypts.
explanation.walkthrough: Graves, with its capital disguised at the start of the clue, is a red or white wine from the Bordeaux region, not a burial place.
explanation.definitionFit: Cellars built to store bottles of wine are where a Bordeaux such as Graves would be kept.

clue.text: Growing canine, one of six as previously named

definitions.text: one of six as previously named
definitions.meaning: junior Scouts were formerly called by this name, and are organised in groups of six called sixes

explanation.definitionFit: A wolf's young is a cub; the junior Scouting section, now Cub Scouts, was called this until 1966.

clue.text: Subjects for newspapers

definitions.meaning: citizens of a country, its subjects
the national daily papers, as opposed to local ones

explanation.definitionFit: Nationals are citizens of a state, and the nationals are papers sold across the whole country.

clue.text: Cosmetic that could produce new charm in visage?

indicators.note: the letters could produce something new when rearranged

explanation.surface: Applying a beauty product might give one's face a fresh allure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' looks like the anagram signal, but it supplies N; 'could produce' rearranges N and CHARMINVISAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanishing cream is a skin cream that disappears when rubbed in, a cosmetic base.

clue.text: Reveal Scot's odd 22? Not so

parts.note: unco is a Scots word for strange or odd

indicators.note: the word so is not there, taken away

parts.note: the answer to 22 down is the left-hand page word
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Scot reveals something strange, then denies it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not so' removes SO from VERSO, the answer to 22, leaving VER.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncover something is to reveal it by taking off what hides it.

clue.text: Strong smell on animal -it's puzzling for a Pekingese

parts.note: a tang is a sharp, strong taste or smell
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A Pekingese dog is baffled by a pungent sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: Pekingese suggests the dog, but here it means a native of Peking (Beijing).
explanation.definitionFit: A tangram is a Chinese puzzle of seven pieces forming shapes, so it is a puzzle for someone from Peking.

clue.text: Political group's head's pronouncement

indicators.note: a pronouncement is something spoken, so the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: block is slang for the head, as in knock someone's block off

explanation.surface: A party leader makes an official statement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Political group's head' reads as the party leader, but 'head' is the slang word block, said aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is an alliance of parties or nations acting together politically.

clue.text: Indian drink provided by young woman out East

indicators.note: the abbreviation for East is out, left out of the word

parts.note: lassie is a young woman, chiefly in Scotland
E is the compass abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: A girl from the Orient serves a yoghurt drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassi is a yoghurt-based drink from India.

clue.text: A lot of precedents about country overturned

parts.note: ca is short for circa, about

indicators.note: in a down clue, overturned means read upwards, back to front

parts.note: Wales is a country of the UK

explanation.surface: A country's many rulings have been overturned.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'overturned' reads the country from bottom to top; 'A lot of' belongs to the definition, since case law is a whole body of rulings.
explanation.definitionFit: Case law is the body of law built from judicial precedents rather than statutes.

clue.text: Form of drawing Peter and Paul arranged to examine

indicators.note: the two names are arranged into a new order

parts.note: to check is to examine

explanation.surface: Two saints are set up to inspect a sketch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawing' suggests sketching, but this is a drawn game in chess.
explanation.definitionFit: Perpetual check in chess forces a draw when one side can keep checking endlessly.

clue.text: Be revealing, in the fashion of Paris

definitions.meaning: to disclose a secret, admit what one knows
... is French for the tone or style, the fashion as Parisians would say it

explanation.definitionFit: To let on is to divulge something; read as French, the letters say 'the tone' or 'the style'.

clue.text: Agreement to include old partners in survey of people

indicators.note: one word is made to include the others, so they go inside it

parts.note: a census is an official count of a population
North and South are partners at the bridge table
North and South are partners at the bridge table

explanation.surface: A deal is reached to count former spouses in a population count.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old partners' suggests exes, but it is O plus N and S, the bridge partners North and South, which go after the C of CENSUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Consensus is general agreement among a group.

clue.text: Irritated about mixing styles

parts.note: cross means annoyed or irritated
over means about, as in a row over money

explanation.surface: Someone is annoyed by the blending of genres.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossover is a work that blends two genres or styles, such as jazz and classical.

clue.text: Boy swallowing a bottle of medicine

indicators.note: the boy swallowing something takes it inside him

parts.note: Phil is a boy's name, short for Philip

explanation.surface: A child gulps down a bottle of medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: A phial is a small glass bottle, typically for medicine.

clue.text: Metal-worker's heat-source

definitions.meaning: a brasier or ... is a worker in brass
a portable stand holding burning coals for warmth

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a craftsman in brass and a pan of burning coal for heating.

clue.text: Book covered in vellum at the workshop

indicators.note: the letters are covered by the surrounding words, sitting inside the phrase

explanation.surface: A volume bound in calfskin at the bindery.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests an old manuscript, but 'Book' is a book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Matthew is the first Gospel, a book of the New Testament.

clue.text: Moving quickly, having captured bishop with queen —- sign of things to come

indicators.note: the first word has captured, taken inside it, the next

parts.note: haring means running fast, like a hare
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A chess move, rushing in to take a bishop with the queen, foretells the outcome.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess picture is false; bishop and queen supply B and ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbinger is a herald or omen announcing something to come.

clue.text: Once viewed old things differently

indicators.note: the word things is set out differently, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Antiques look different once you have actually seen them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old things' reads as antiques in the surface, but 'old' gives its abbreviation and 'differently' acts on 'things' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: On sight means as soon as something is seen, as in shoot on sight.

clue.text: Leading soldier in charge with volunteer outside

indicators.note: the word for volunteer goes outside the other letters

parts.note: to offer is to volunteer

explanation.surface: A commander leads troops with a volunteer standing outside.
explanation.definitionFit: An officer is a soldier holding command, leading the ranks.

clue.text: Transatlantic sailor turned up with firm's American export

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top, reversed

parts.note: John Cabot sailed across the Atlantic to North America in 1497
Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A seaman back from crossing the ocean delivers a company's goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Tobacco, grown in Virginia since colonial times, has long been a major American export.

clue.text: Figure of girl putting on a little weight

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
a gram is a small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A young woman's figure shows she has put on a few grams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' plays on body shape, but here it is a drawing.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagram is a figure in a book, a drawing illustrating a point.

clue.text: Daughter is left on yacht to have a good time

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A girl is abandoned on a boat to enjoy herself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' suggests abandonment, but on a yacht it is PORT.
explanation.definitionFit: To disport oneself is to amuse oneself, to frolic and enjoy.

clue.text: Divine female, one who works beneath Virginia

parts.note: a miner works beneath the ground
VA is the postal abbreviation for Virginia

explanation.surface: A goddess is served by a labourer under an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Minerva was the Roman goddess of wisdom.

clue.text: Early part of flu, always

indicators.note: the earliest part of the word is its first letter

parts.note: ever means always, as in ever hopeful

explanation.surface: A temperature is the first symptom of influenza, without fail.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised temperature is typically the first sign that influenza has struck, so the whole clue describes it.

clue.text: Part of spread that's left

parts.note: a spread here is two facing pages of an open book, and the page on the left side

explanation.surface: Some of a buffet remains uneaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Verso is the left-hand page of an open book, the back of a leaf.

clue.text: Once bit is broken, it produces two pieces

indicators.note: the letters are broken up and reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: When you snap a bit, you end up with two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: Bisection is cutting something into two parts, so it results in two pieces.

clue.text: Vehicle reduced speed, company including one old master

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: a word reduced is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: pace means speed

indicators.note: the abbreviation for company includes, holds within it, the next piece

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A car slows down, with a firm carrying a valuable old painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' drops the last letter of the speed word. Carpaccio may be better known as a raw beef dish, named after the Venetian painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Vittore Carpaccio was a Venetian Renaissance painter, one of the old masters.

clue.text: Composer, having left in anger, returned

indicators.note: the whole is returned, read back from right to left
the letter goes in the word for anger

parts.note: rage means anger

explanation.surface: A composer storms out in a fury and later comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts L inside RAGE to give RAGLE, which 'returned' turns around.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Edward Elgar was an English composer, known for the Enigma Variations.

clue.text: Part of mouth hit by someone in a temper

definitions.meaning: the palate, the upper surface of the mouth

definitions.text: hit by someone in a temper
definitions.meaning: to hit the ceiling of the house is to lose one's temper

explanation.definitionFit: The palate is the roof of the mouth, and someone furious is said to hit the roof.

clue.text: From the US, OK, or a different state in the East

indicators.note: the letters are made different, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: An American asks whether something is fine or a different country altogether.
explanation.definitionFit: South Korea is a country in East Asia, the Republic of Korea.
